meta.title: perf: Add config option `enableResourceCache` to cache dashboard resources locally for faster loading in additional browser tabs
meta.body_summary: Add a service worker to cache dashboard bundles and register it in login/dashboard entry points, with config option enableResourceCache for faster loading in additional browser tabs.

perf_labels.notes: Codex-initiated service worker caching PR with heavy manual follow-up fixes addressing lifecycle review concerns; merged after CHANGES_REQUESTED resolved.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 243 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, concentrated in service worker and registration logic. It fits a moderate incremental performance PR merged after review iterations.

review_details.concern_detail: CodeRabbit bot flagged missing activate handler for cache cleanup, error handling in fetch, path construction safety, and cache versioning; maintainer mtrezza pressed on activate event timing and naming consistency across code and docs.
review_details.performance_claim: Service worker caching makes dashboard resources load faster when opening additional browser tabs.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Initial AI-authored service worker implementation required maintainer to manually add cache cleanup, error handling, and clarify lifecycle semantics; merge hinged on deep browser API expertise.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer mtrezza manually reviewed service worker lifecycle (activate event timing, cleanup) and requested changes; CodeRabbit bot flagged additional correctness issues.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or timing data; manual testing instructions provided but no recorded performance comparison.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After CHANGES_REQUESTED, maintainer added multiple commits fixing cache cleanup, error handling, path safety, and config renaming.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced a service worker (sw.js) with install/activate/fetch handlers to cache dashboard scripts, styles, and bundle resources; registration module (registerServiceWorker.js) with tab-count-based unregistration; configuration flag enableResourceCache; documentation updates.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merge from alpha brought package.json and package-lock.json changes unrelated to caching.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: add sw.js and registration module (basic cache).
Subsequent commits: add config option, fix service worker persistence after closing tabs, path refinement, naming adjustments.
Review iterations: add activate handler for cache cleanup, error handling, and address naming consistency; final config rename to enableResourceCache.

review_signals.summary: CHANGES_REQUESTED review with three actionable comments about service worker cache handling and path safety.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer addressed all items in subsequent commits.

review_signals.summary: Suggested adding activate event handler to delete old caches.
review_signals.action_taken: Added activate handler in commit e1a8e66.

review_signals.summary: Requested error handling for cache operations.
review_signals.action_taken: Added error handling in fetch handler.

review_signals.summary: Flagged that service worker path may break without trailing slash.
Asked about using clients.claim() and when activate is called.
review_signals.action_taken: Addressed in discussion and final code.

review_signals.summary: APPROVED review after maintainer addressed all concerns.

collaboration_trajectory: OpenAI_Codex (via mtrezza) opened PR with initial service worker and cache logic.
CodeRabbit bot provided CHANGES_REQUESTED with multiple actionable issues within ~19h.
Maintainer mtrezza iterated with several commits fixing cache cleanup, error handling, path normalization, and config naming.
After discussion on activate event semantics, CodeRabbit approved, and PR merged in ~25.7h.
